channel.title: AI News Radar
channel.description: A curated 24-hour radar of AI news: official releases, new models and high-signal discussion.

item.title: OpenAI to acquire Pierre Computer Company, Inc.
item.description: OpenAI will acquire Pierre Computer Company, folding Pierre's Trees and Diffs libraries—already used by Codex—and its Code Storage feature into Codex while keeping them open source. (OpenAI News)

item.title: A Closer Look at Phonon TTS. Launching High-Quality On-Device Speech That Tops the Benchmarks.
item.description: Phonon 31m, a 65MB–75MB on-device TTS model with 100+ voices across English, French, German, Spanish and Portuguese, drew over 200,000 downloads in two weeks as Apache 2.0 open weights and details its Hugging Face Open TTS Leaderboard results. (Hugging Face Blog)

item.title: GitHub Copilot is now available in Xcode’s coding assistant
item.description: GitHub Copilot is now in public preview inside Xcode 27.3 beta’s built-in coding assistant, requiring macOS Tahoe 26.6 or later and setup via Settings > Intelligence, with all Copilot plans supported and the original Xcode extension retained. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Setting a new standard for responsible AI infrastructure
item.description: OpenAI's National Community Compact commits its future self-operated compute campuses to pay all electricity and infrastructure costs, provide financial guarantees upfront, and publish water, energy and noise studies while barring NDAs with public officials. (OpenAI News)

item.title: Dharma Field Extractor: Any Document In, Structured Fields in JSON Out
item.description: Dharma Field Extractor, a 2-billion-parameter model trained with LoRA on 43,384 samples, converts any document type into JSON fields specified by an open request or schema, which Dharma-AI says outperforms every frontier LLM tested at a fraction of the cost. (Hugging Face Blog)

item.title: CodeQL 2.27.4 improves accuracy and query metadata
item.description: CodeQL 2.27.4 improves query accuracy for Java/Kotlin, Rust and C/C++, strengthens security checks when bundling or publishing a pack, and corrects query metadata. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: AI helps user successfully "jailbreak" a treadmill: Claude easily dismantles the iFIT paywall, instantly turning the big screen into free streaming media
item.description: A Reddit user spent about a day and a half using Claude Code to break the iFIT subscription wall on a NordicTrack Commercial 2250 treadmill, freeing its 10-inch screen for any streaming service, with the code now on GitHub. (AIbase)

item.title: Does AI Make Death Optional? Brockman Raises Life's Ultimate Question
item.description: At the Wall Street Journal Tech Summit, OpenAI President Greg Brockman claimed death may become optional in the future and that biological breakthroughs matter beyond humans, a claim examined here alongside AI frontier questions. (AIbase)

item.title: Claude Code's star-making mastermind poached: OpenAI lands Cat Wu
item.description: OpenAI hired former Claude Code product lead Cat Wu to oversee AI agents, after she helped take Claude Code from internal prototype to commercialization and past $2.5 billion annualized revenue by February 2026. (AIbase)

item.title: Developing super AI could bring 20 years in prison: US Democrats propose strictest ban yet
item.description: U.S. Democrats' draft Ban on Artificial Superintelligence Act would outlaw developing or deploying superintelligent AI, letting courts dissolve offending companies and imposing up to 20 years' federal prison, sentencing compared to illegal nuclear weapons work—though it remains only a draft. (AIbase)

item.title: Claude Code product lead Cat Wu makes lightning exit as three core members depart within two weeks
item.description: Claude Code product lead Cat Wu left Anthropic and joined OpenAI in a core product role one day later, as Thariq Shihipar and Anthony Morris exited within ten days, the third core departure in two weeks. (AIbase)

item.title: Kimi Hosted Agents launches, shifting Harness runtime to cloud hosting
item.description: On November 5, Kimi Open Platform launched Kimi Hosted Agents, turning its Harness runtime into a cloud service with 140+ Skills, 30+ plugins, long-task support and multi-agent collaboration. (AIbase)

item.title: ChatGPT Images 2.6 — GIFs, reusable reference images and 50% faster generation
item.description: ChatGPT Images 2.6 adds GIF generation and reusable reference images while speeding up generation by 50% versus earlier versions, and the piece details how these changes affect output and workflow. (Product Hunt)

item.title: Gemini for Home now plugs into AT&T’s smart security system
item.description: AT&T's Connected Life System is the first home security system to integrate with Gemini for Home, letting subscribers on the $29.99/month plan get AI event summaries and search recorded video history. (The Verge)

item.title: Sand.ai announces completion of a $200 million Series A+ funding round, with backing from multiple investors and Shanghai state capital.
item.description: Sand.ai, a frontier company focused on video large-model R&D, completed a $200 million A+ round led jointly by Cornerstone Capital and Wangsu Science & Technology, with Shanghai state-backed investors including Pudong Venture Capital and Shanghai Guofang participating. (AIbase)

item.title: AI Employees by Easy-Peasy.AI — Hire an AI team that splits the work and asks before sending
item.description: Easy-Peasy.AI's AI Employees promises an AI team that splits work and asks before sending, though the page itself only displays a CAPTCHA security check, leaving product details unverifiable. (Product Hunt)

item.title: From drawing to editing: OpenAI rounds out its image generation workflow with Images 2.6
item.description: OpenAI's Images 2.6 targets editing workflows with roughly 50% faster generation, GIF support and stronger multi-turn consistency, as users create 4 billion images weekly across ChatGPT, Codex and the API—over 500 million daily. (AIbase)

item.title: Qualcomm Cloud AI 100 Ultra: a 150W AI accelerator card with 128GB of memory and 548GB/s transfer speed
item.description: Qualcomm Cloud AI 100 Ultra: a 150W AI accelerator card with 128GB of memory and 548GB/s transfer speed (www.qualcomm.com)

item.title: Stitch.ai — Your AI workspace for mail, calendar, notes, tasks and more
item.description: Stitch.ai is billed as an AI workspace combining mail, calendar, notes and tasks, yet the page itself shows only a CAPTCHA security check, offering no product features, pricing or team details. (Product Hunt)
